newsitem.title: USA: Employee Solutions to acquire CMRG Inc.
newsitem.headline: Employee Solutions to acquire CMRG Inc.

text.p: Employee Solutions Inc on Thursday said it would acquire CMGR Inc, an employee leasing firm whose clients include professional, service and light industrial companies.
CMGR generates about $55 million in annual revenues and handles some 1,700 employees for about 75 clients in New York, New Jersey and Philadelphia.
The company expects the deal to accrete to earnings in 1997. It will pay a total $3.85 million in cash -- $1.5 million down and the remainder at closing.
Employee Solutions, which is also a staff leasing company, said the price was three to five times adjusted pretax earnings.
